query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, pp.channelId, sc.name as channelName, pp.price 
FROM products p 
LEFT JOIN productPrices pp ON p.id = pp.productId
LEFT JOIN salesChannels sc ON pp.channelId = sc.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '43 700ml%'
ORDER BY p.id, pp.channelId
